title: Run mac-cleanup to remove caches and junk
summary: Use the mac-cleanup tool to automatically remove system caches and unnecessary files. This helps free up disk space and can improve system performance.

steps.explain: Run the mac-cleanup command to start the automatic cleanup process. The tool will scan for and remove caches and junk files.
steps.expect: The cleanup process starts and displays progress or a summary of removed items.

rollback.explain: There is no direct undo command for mac-cleanup. To prevent accidental data loss in the future, use the dry-run mode first.

warnings: This tool deletes files automatically. Ensure you have backups of important data if you are unsure about what is being removed.
Always consider running a dry-run first to see what files will be deleted.
